what: Two mutants review found against the round-1 LegendCompletenessTests, re-run against the round-2 rewrite that scopes both checks to the legend array's tuple captions with comments stripped first. Re-run a second time after the legend was restructured to eight rows (AssertLabelsFit fix), against the final committed state of this round.
method: Each mutant was applied to a plain filesystem copy of the worktree outside the repo tree (C:/gamedev/_mut-222, removed afterward), never to a tracked file, so no revert of tracked source was needed.

mutants.name: rename_visible_caption_leave_stale_comment_word
mutants.reviewClaim: Renaming the visible caption (amber=fighting -> amber=combat) while a plausible neighboring comment still says the old words left both tests green under the round-1 guard.
mutants.old_string:
// live subtree (see HudReadabilityTests.AuthoredHud).
                     ("dot: blue=idle amber=fighting pink=fled green=working gray=downed", 8, "#bfdbfe"),
mutants.expected: State_dot_colors_are_named_in_legend fails (fighting no longer found among parsed captions); CreateLegend_authors_the_expected_number_of_legend_rows stays green (row count unchanged).
mutants.observed: Всего тестов: 2 Пройдено: 1 Не пройдено: 1. State_dot_colors_are_named_in_legend FAIL: Assert.Contains() Failure: Filter not matched in collection. Collection dump shows the mutated caption reading ‘...amber=combat pink=fled...’. CreateLegend_authors_the_expected_number_of_legend_rows PASS (row count still 8).

mutants.name: innocuous_comment_containing_paren_quote_inside_array
mutants.reviewClaim: A benign explanatory comment containing the two characters (" inside the array literal broke the round-1 row count from 10 to 11 with no behaviour change.
mutants.old_string:
("light warm block = diggable rock / dark = map edge", 8, "#d6d3d1"),
                     ("red X = unreachable / pale tile = new floor / gray dot = loose stone", 8, "#fca5a5"),
mutants.expected: Both tests stay green: the comment is stripped before either check runs, so it cannot be mistaken for a tuple's leading (" and cannot change the caption count.
mutants.observed: Всего тестов: 2 Пройдено: 2 Не пройдено: 0. Both LegendCompletenessTests facts pass.

note: Mutant (b)'s insertion point moved from the old 'amber X = dig mark' row (round 1 layout) to 'light warm block / red X = unreachable' (round 2 layout), because that row was folded into the merged LEGEND heading row while fixing the AssertLabelsFit overflow (see evidence/222-crowd-frame.json). The mechanism under test — comment stripping before caption extraction — is identical; only the specific adjacent rows used to host the mutant changed.
